summary: A diary puts a household quarrel next to a public event without connecting them.
realLife: Pepys wrote that he read the trials of the men hanged for the King's death, then quarreled with his wife over the dog.
sources: Diary of Samuel Pepys, November 1660, Wikisource: https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/Diary_of_Samuel_Pepys/1660/November
inGame: needs: a household friction record the diary can place beside the address; the household records hold arguments only in scenes.

turns.writesBack: the entry says a kind thing about someone in the house

turns.turn: The quarrel is about the news.
